collection.clock: Every read and seam brackets runner UTC+monotonic time; page has separate timeOrigin+performance.now. Total bracket/skew is recorded; no atomic claim.

collection.Performance: Enable before first snapshot. Missing page heap/CDP metrics are unavailable/null, never zero.
collection.observers: DOM/CSS enable is deliberately observed before cold open, matching existing harness order. Font walk/computed style/CDP query cost is separate from warm render. Release only after dispose.
collection.nativeOpenBoundary: Existing API fixture/admission/mount/fonts/stable native layout plus source TreeWalker inventory are combined; no invented admission-only memory seam.
collection.deferredBoundary: Explicit geometry reads can force browser style/layout. Three RAF callbacks do not certify paint completion.
collection.finalGC: Exactly one HeapProfiler.collectGarbage after dispose and observer release; before/after diagnostic values never qualify any performance target.
collection.media: No media mode/emulateMedia change. Record matchMedia(print) at each numeric snapshot. At explicit deferred layout seam ONLY, record effective display/position/overflow of container/representative page/copy and print stylesheet rule-presence booleans. The immediate print pair precedes these style reads. Observed screen print-DOM build is not an actual print-media benchmark and does not explain preprint RSS by itself.
collection.failureRecords: Persist each read RUNNING start before IO, then completed or failed/aborted bracket. Retain actual offending owned RSS/PID measurement before failclosed threshold exception. Phase deadlines checked on monotonic settlement as well as timers.

guards.failure: First guard/monitor/console/cleanup error stops; no automatic retry or identical second attempt.
